purpose: Conservative, evidence-based readiness score for a safely automated platform with human oversight for consequential decisions. Not a claim of code completion or autonomous production operation.

scoring_method.method: Weighted capability rubric. Each dimension receives a 0-100 evidence score; weighted contribution = score * weight / 100.

levels.25: Prototype or draft implementation; not production-integrated
levels.50: Implemented and tested in CI, but not production-integrated
levels.100: End-to-end operation repeatedly evidenced, monitored, recoverable, and independently reviewable

scoring_method.caveat: Scores between rubric levels are allowed only where a measured coverage ratio exists. Overall index is provisional and must be recalculated when source evidence changes.

dimensions.name: Public/customer experience
dimensions.basis: Static public site and browser-local enquiry/service tools exist; README states login/signup, server telemetry, live integrations and sales are not connected.

dimensions.name: Catalog/product production
dimensions.basis: Main production snapshot reports 5,000 catalog identities against 5,000 target; 4,716 produced/QC-passed. 4,716/5,000 = 94.32%.

dimensions.name: QC and release gate
dimensions.basis: 4,716 of 5,000 catalog items covered by QC; 4,716 passed and 0 failed among produced items. Dispatch release remains 0; 100% pass rate applies only to produced subset.

dimensions.name: Order lifecycle
dimensions.basis: PR #3796 is Draft/unmerged. Current head 9158bfd8e5b1f9ceb2f83b3d530de7697f80a624 has 15 associated PR workflow runs reported successful; this is not production integration.

dimensions.name: Payment and reconciliation
dimensions.basis: Fail-closed payment webhook baseline exists, but no provider-backed live payment or claimed payment is evidenced. Manual bank-statement match remains owner-attested, not independent/provider verification.

dimensions.name: Delivery and customer acceptance
dimensions.basis: Lifecycle code/test path exists in Draft PR #3796; acceptance is owner-recorded, not customer-authenticated. No production dispatch or delivery is evidenced.

dimensions.name: Private evidence and customer authentication
dimensions.basis: Multiple overlapping Draft PRs propose provider-neutral storage contracts; no real private storage provider, credentials, upload route, or production wiring is evidenced.

dimensions.name: Connected AI, research and media
dimensions.basis: README identifies browser-local drafting/research/media tools and explicitly says connected AI, independent fact-checking, live avatar/voice/video and publishing integrations are not connected.

dimensions.name: Automation and monitoring
dimensions.basis: Many workflows and automation checks exist and current PR #3796 workflows report success; generated federation health is UNKNOWN and some agent-run status files are stale. Workflow success is not proof of live autonomous operations.

dimensions.name: Independent verification
dimensions.basis: Latest main verification snapshot: 0 verified of 100,200 records; human review is required before promotion.

dimensions.name: Backup and recovery
dimensions.basis: Encrypted Render PostgreSQL backup work is Draft (#3790); no verified production backup-and-restore drill is evidenced.

operational_outcomes.note: The 26.68/100 weighted engineering-readiness index is not a revenue, customer adoption, scientific validity, or end-to-end autonomy percentage. The evidenced production transaction outcome (paid customer order through dispatch/delivery) remains 0.

critical_open_gaps: No evidenced paid customer order through payment, dispatch, delivery and customer-confirmed acceptance.
No production private evidence storage or authenticated guest consent/acceptance.
No provider-verified payment integration; owner attestation must remain separately labelled.
Connected AI/research/media services remain prototypes or unverified integrations.
Federation health snapshot is UNKNOWN and not live cross-repository health evidence.

anti_duplication.decision: No new implementation for evidence storage or guest-order lifecycle is duplicated here. This audit is a read-only scorecard. Related Draft PRs require consolidation/review before further implementation.

safety.human_oversight_required_for: payment disputes/refunds, customer consent and acceptance, independent verification, production release, security and recovery approvals
